title: Ship a deterministic bootstrap and one complete accountable mutation vertical slice
desired_change: Add installation prerequisites, local bootstrap, exact commands, executable fixtures, a reference implementation, failure recovery, and one bounded extension that runs intent → Proposed Move → authority → eval → mutation → Ledger → receipt → projection → outcome debt.
expected_outcome: A competent outsider can run, inspect, break, repair, and extend the system without oral guidance.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: Concept-only machinery can be mistaken for working safety and authority controls.

hidden_context_dependencies: The repository has no package manifest, bootstrap script, environment contract, runbook, or local stack.
The docs describe interfaces and lifecycle but contain no executable implementation.
No valid or invalid schema fixtures exist.
No example demonstrates receipt reconstruction or projection rebuild.
The tribunal cannot extend one bounded capability because none is implemented.
acceptance_checks: A clean environment completes bootstrap from documented commands.
Positive and negative fixtures run deterministically.
A receipt reconstructs transition, authority, evidence, and outcome debt.
A contributor adds one bounded capability using only repository instructions.
A documented failure can be induced and recovered.
